subject: Maths
question: What is the highest power of 6 that divides 100!?
solution: 6 = 2 × 3, and 3s are scarcer than 2s. Factors of 3 in 100!: 33 + 11 + 3 + 1 = 48; factors of 2: 97. So 6⁴⁸.

question: For how many natural numbers n from 1 to 100 is 4ⁿ + 1 divisible by 17?
solution: 4² = 16 leaves −1 on division by 17, so powers of 4 leave 4, −1, −4, 1 and repeat every 4. 4ⁿ + 1 is divisible by 17 when 4ⁿ leaves −1, i.e. when n leaves 2 on division by 4: n = 2, 6, ..., 98, which is 25 values.
questionHi: 1 से 100 तक कितनी प्राकृत संख्याओं n के लिए 4ⁿ + 1, 17 से विभाज्य है?

subject: Maths
question: What is the smallest number written only with the digit 9 (9, 99, 999, ...) that is divisible by 13?
solution: 99...9 = 10ᵏ − 1. Powers of 10 on division by 13 leave 10, 9, 12, 3, 4, 1 - the first 1 is at k = 6. So 999,999 = 13 × 76,923 is the first (it is 999 × 1,001, and 1,001 = 7 × 11 × 13).
questionHi: केवल अंक 9 से लिखी (9, 99, 999, ...) वह सबसे छोटी संख्या कौन-सी है जो 13 से विभाज्य हो?

subject: Maths
question: What is the smallest number of 4s in a number written only with the digit 4 (44...4) that is divisible by 33?
solution: For 3 the digit sum 4k must be a multiple of 3, so k is a multiple of 3. For 11 the alternate sums must match, so k is even. The smallest k that is both is 6 (444,444 = 33 × 13,468).
questionHi: केवल अंक 4 से लिखी संख्या (44...4) में 33 से विभाज्य होने के लिए कम से कम कितने 4 होने चाहिए?
solutionHi: 3 के लिए अंकों का योग 4k, 3 का गुणज हो, अतः k, 3 का गुणज। 11 के लिए एकांतर योग बराबर हों, अतः k सम। दोनों शर्तों वाला सबसे छोटा k = 6 (444,444 = 33 × 13,468)।

question: How many numbers below 10,000 are divisible by each of 6, 10 and 15 but not by 4?
solution: Divisible by 6, 10 and 15 means divisible by their LCM 30: 333 numbers below 10,000. Those also divisible by 4 are the multiples of 60: 166. 333 − 166 = 167.
questionHi: 10,000 से कम कितनी संख्याएँ 6, 10 और 15 में से प्रत्येक से विभाज्य हैं पर 4 से नहीं?

subject: Maths
question: How many numbers from 1 to 2,025 have no factor in common with 2,025 other than 1?
solution: 2,025 = 3⁴ × 5², so the number must be divisible by neither 3 nor 5. Multiples of 3: 675, of 5: 405, of 15: 135; either: 675 + 405 − 135 = 945. 2,025 − 945 = 1,080.
questionHi: 1 से 2,025 तक कितनी संख्याओं का 2,025 के साथ 1 के अतिरिक्त कोई उभयनिष्ठ गुणनखंड नहीं है?

subject: Maths
question: What is the largest number that divides ab(a² − b²) for all natural numbers a and b?
solution: ab(a² − b²) = ab(a − b)(a + b). If a or b is even it is even; if both are odd, a − b is even. For 3: if neither a nor b is a multiple of 3, then a² and b² both leave 1, so a² − b² is a multiple of 3. So 6 always divides it; a = 2, b = 1 gives 2 × 3 = 6 itself.
questionHi: वह सबसे बड़ी संख्या कौन-सी है जो सभी प्राकृत संख्याओं a और b के लिए ab(a² − b²) को विभाजित करती है?
solutionHi: ab(a² − b²) = ab(a − b)(a + b)। a या b सम हो तो यह सम; दोनों विषम हों तो a − b सम। 3 के लिए: यदि a और b में कोई 3 का गुणज नहीं, तो a² और b² दोनों का शेष 1, अतः a² − b², 3 का गुणज। अतः 6 सदा विभाजित करता है; a = 2, b = 1 पर 2 × 3 = 6 ही।

question: For every natural number n, 3⁵ⁿ − 2⁵ⁿ is divisible by:
solution: 3⁵ⁿ − 2⁵ⁿ = 243ⁿ − 32ⁿ, and aⁿ − bⁿ is always divisible by a − b = 243 − 32 = 211. n = 1 gives 211 itself, so 275, 243 and 31 do not always divide it.

subject: Maths
question: What is the largest three-digit number that leaves a remainder of 4 when divided by each of 6, 9 and 15?
solution: The number minus 4 is divisible by 6, 9 and 15, i.e. by their LCM 90. The largest three-digit number of the form 90k + 4 is 90 × 11 + 4 = 994.
questionHi: तीन अंकों की वह सबसे बड़ी संख्या कौन-सी है जिसे 6, 9 और 15 में से प्रत्येक से भाग देने पर 4 शेष बचता है?
solutionHi: संख्या − 4, 6, 9 और 15 से, यानी उनके LCM 90 से विभाज्य। 90k + 4 के रूप की सबसे बड़ी तीन अंकों की संख्या 90 × 11 + 4 = 994।

question: For how many natural numbers n is n⁴ + 4 a prime number?
solution: n⁴ + 4 = (n² + 2)² − (2n)² = (n² − 2n + 2)(n² + 2n + 2). For n > 1 both factors are greater than 1, so it is not prime. Only n = 1 gives 1 × 5 = 5, a prime. So exactly 1.
questionHi: कितनी प्राकृत संख्याओं n के लिए n⁴ + 4 एक अभाज्य संख्या है?
solutionHi: n⁴ + 4 = (n² + 2)² − (2n)² = (n² − 2n + 2)(n² + 2n + 2)। n > 1 के लिए दोनों गुणनखंड 1 से बड़े, अतः अभाज्य नहीं। केवल n = 1 पर 1 × 5 = 5, अभाज्य। अतः ठीक 1।

subject: Maths
question: How many numbers from 1 to 100 cannot be written as the difference of the squares of two whole numbers?
solution: a² − b² = (a − b)(a + b), and a − b and a + b are both even or both odd. So the difference is odd or a multiple of 4 - every such number works (2k + 1 = (k + 1)² − k², 4k = (k + 1)² − (k − 1)²). Numbers leaving 2 on division by 4 never work: 2, 6, ..., 98, which is 25.
questionHi: 1 से 100 तक कितनी संख्याएँ दो पूर्ण संख्याओं के वर्गों के अंतर के रूप में नहीं लिखी जा सकतीं?
solutionHi: a² − b² = (a − b)(a + b), और a − b तथा a + b दोनों सम या दोनों विषम। अतः अंतर विषम या 4 का गुणज होता है - ऐसी हर संख्या बनती है (2k + 1 = (k + 1)² − k², 4k = (k + 1)² − (k − 1)²)। 4 से शेष 2 वाली संख्याएँ कभी नहीं: 2, 6, ..., 98, यानी 25।

question: How many three-digit numbers are equal to 11 times the sum of their digits?
solution: 100a + 10b + c = 11(a + b + c) gives 89a = b + 10c. The right side is at most 99, so a = 1 and b + 10c = 89: c = 8, b = 9. The only number is 198 = 11 × 18: 1.

question: What is the least natural number that must be added to 10²⁰²⁵ to make it divisible by 11?
solution: 10 leaves −1 on division by 11, so 10²⁰²⁵ (an odd power) leaves −1, i.e. 10. Adding 1 makes it divisible: 10²⁰²⁵ + 1 = 100...001 has alternate sums 1 and 1.
questionHi: 10²⁰²⁵ में कम से कम कौन-सी प्राकृत संख्या जोड़ें कि वह 11 से विभाज्य हो जाए?
solutionHi: 11 से भाग पर 10 का शेष −1, अतः 10²⁰²⁵ (विषम घात) का शेष −1, यानी 10। 1 जोड़ने पर विभाज्य: 10²⁰²⁵ + 1 = 100...001 के एकांतर योग 1 और 1।

question: How many seven-digit numbers that use each of the digits 1 to 7 exactly once are divisible by 11?
solution: The four digits in odd places and the three in even places add to 28. Their difference must be a multiple of 11, and the only possibility is 0: both groups add to 14. The groups of four digits adding to 14 are {1, 2, 4, 7}, {1, 2, 5, 6}, {1, 3, 4, 6} and {2, 3, 4, 5}. Each gives 4! × 3! = 144 numbers: 4 × 144 = 576.

question: What is the smallest natural number n for which 7ⁿ − 1 is divisible by 1,000?
solution: 7⁴ = 2,401 ends in 401. Then 7⁸ ends in 801, 7¹² in 201, 7¹⁶ in 601 and 7²⁰ in 001 (the hundreds digit goes up by 4 each time). Checking 7, 7², 7⁵ and 7¹⁰ (ending 007, 049, 807, 249) shows no smaller n works: n = 20.

question: How many three-digit numbers are divisible by 13 but not by 5?
solution: Three-digit multiples of 13: 104 = 13 × 8 to 988 = 13 × 76, which is 69. Those divisible by 5 are multiples of 65: 130 = 65 × 2 to 975 = 65 × 15, which is 14. 69 − 14 = 55.

question: For every whole number n, 3 × 5²ⁿ⁺¹ + 2³ⁿ⁺¹ is divisible by:
solution: 3 × 5²ⁿ⁺¹ + 2³ⁿ⁺¹ = 15 × 25ⁿ + 2 × 8ⁿ. 25 = 17 + 8, so 25ⁿ leaves the same remainder as 8ⁿ on division by 17, and the sum leaves the same as 15 × 8ⁿ + 2 × 8ⁿ = 17 × 8ⁿ, i.e. 0. n = 0 gives 15 + 2 = 17 itself.

question: Which of the following divides 2²⁰²⁶ + 1?
solution: 2²⁰²⁶ + 1 = 4¹⁰¹³ + 1, and for an odd power xⁿ + 1 is divisible by x + 1 = 5. On division by 3 it leaves 2; 2⁸ leaves 1 on division by 17 and 2026 = 8 × 253 + 2, so it leaves 4 + 1 = 5; on division by 13 it leaves 11.
questionHi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन 2²⁰²⁶ + 1 को विभाजित करता है?
solutionHi: 2²⁰²⁶ + 1 = 4¹⁰¹³ + 1, और विषम घात के लिए xⁿ + 1, x + 1 = 5 से विभाज्य। 3 से शेष 2; 17 से भाग पर 2⁸ का शेष 1 और 2026 = 8 × 253 + 2, अतः शेष 4 + 1 = 5; 13 से शेष 11।

subject: Maths
question: How many four-digit numbers divisible by 99 have all their digits even?
solution: For abcd divisible by 99, the two-digit blocks ab + cd must be 99 or 198. 198 needs 99 + 99, which has odd digits. For ab + cd = 99 the units digits b + d add to 9 (there is no carry possible), so one of them is odd. So none: 0.
questionHi: 99 से विभाज्य चार अंकों की कितनी संख्याओं के सभी अंक सम हैं?
solutionHi: abcd के 99 से विभाज्य होने के लिए दो-अंकीय खंड ab + cd, 99 या 198 हों। 198 के लिए 99 + 99, जिसके अंक विषम। ab + cd = 99 में इकाई अंक b + d = 9, अतः एक विषम। अतः कोई नहीं: 0।

subject: Maths
question: How many two-digit multiples of 7 remain multiples of 7 when their digits are reversed?
solution: 10a + b and 10b + a both divisible by 7 means their difference 9(a − b) is too, so a − b is a multiple of 7: a = b or a − b = ±7. a = b gives 77 (11a is a multiple of 7 only for a = 7). a − b = 7 gives 70 (reversed 07 = 7), 81 and 92; only 70 is a multiple of 7. b − a = 7 gives 18 and 29, neither. So 70 and 77: 2.
questionHi: 7 के दो अंकों के कितने गुणज अंक उलटने पर भी 7 के गुणज रहते हैं?
solutionHi: 10a + b और 10b + a दोनों 7 से विभाज्य, अतः उनका अंतर 9(a − b) भी, यानी a − b, 7 का गुणज: a = b या a − b = ±7। a = b से 77 (11a, 7 का गुणज केवल a = 7 पर)। a − b = 7 से 70 (उलटकर 07 = 7), 81 और 92; केवल 70, 7 का गुणज। b − a = 7 से 18 और 29, कोई नहीं। अतः 70 और 77: 2।

question: What is the highest power of 15 that divides 150!?
solution: 15 = 3 × 5, and 5s are scarcer. Factors of 5 in 150!: 30 + 6 + 1 = 37; factors of 3: 50 + 16 + 5 + 1 = 72. So 15³⁷.

question: Which of the following does NOT divide 5³⁶ − 1?
solution: 5ⁿ − 1 is divisible by a prime p when n is a multiple of the first power of 5 that leaves 1 on division by p. That first power is 5⁴ for 13, 5⁶ for 7, 5⁹ for 19 and 5⁵ for 11. 4, 6 and 9 divide 36; 5 does not. So 11 does not divide 5³⁶ − 1.
questionHi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन 5³⁶ − 1 को विभाजित नहीं करता?
solutionHi: 5ⁿ − 1, अभाज्य p से तब विभाज्य जब n, 5 की उस पहली घात का गुणज हो जिसका p से शेष 1 है। वह पहली घात 13 के लिए 5⁴, 7 के लिए 5⁶, 19 के लिए 5⁹ और 11 के लिए 5⁵। 4, 6 और 9, 36 को विभाजित करते हैं; 5 नहीं। अतः 11, 5³⁶ − 1 को विभाजित नहीं करता।

subject: Maths
question: For how many natural numbers n from 1 to 100 is 3ⁿ + 4ⁿ divisible by 7?
solution: 4 leaves −3 on division by 7, so 3ⁿ + 4ⁿ leaves the same as 3ⁿ + (−3)ⁿ: 0 for odd n, 2 × 3ⁿ (never 0) for even n. So exactly the 50 odd values of n.
questionHi: 1 से 100 तक कितनी प्राकृत संख्याओं n के लिए 3ⁿ + 4ⁿ, 7 से विभाज्य है?
solutionHi: 7 से भाग पर 4 का शेष −3, अतः 3ⁿ + 4ⁿ का शेष 3ⁿ + (−3)ⁿ जैसा: विषम n पर 0, सम n पर 2 × 3ⁿ (कभी 0 नहीं)। अतः ठीक 50 विषम मान।

subject: Maths
question: For how many natural numbers n from 1 to 99 is n(n + 1) divisible by 12?
solution: n(n + 1) needs 4 and 3. Only one of n, n + 1 is even, so it must be a multiple of 4: n leaves 0 or 3 on division by 4. And n or n + 1 is a multiple of 3: n leaves 0 or 2 on division by 3. Together n leaves 0, 3, 8 or 11 on division by 12 - 4 in every 12. 1 to 96 gives 32, and 99 adds one more: 33.
questionHi: 1 से 99 तक कितनी प्राकृत संख्याओं n के लिए n(n + 1), 12 से विभाज्य है?
solutionHi: n(n + 1) को 4 और 3 चाहिए। n, n + 1 में केवल एक सम, अतः वही 4 का गुणज: n का 4 से शेष 0 या 3। और n या n + 1, 3 का गुणज: n का 3 से शेष 0 या 2। मिलाकर n का 12 से शेष 0, 3, 8 या 11 - हर 12 में 4। 1 से 96 में 32, और 99 एक और: 33।

subject: Maths
question: What is the largest number that divides p⁶ − 1 for every prime number p greater than 7?
solution: p⁶ − 1 = (p − 1)(p + 1)(p² + p + 1)(p² − p + 1). For p odd, (p − 1)(p + 1) has 8. p⁶ leaves 1 on division by 9 and by 7 whenever p is not a multiple of 3 or 7. So 8 × 9 × 7 = 504 always divides it. 11⁶ − 1 = 504 × 3,515 and 13⁶ − 1 = 504 × 9,577 share nothing more.
questionHi: 7 से बड़ी प्रत्येक अभाज्य संख्या p के लिए p⁶ − 1 को विभाजित करने वाली सबसे बड़ी संख्या कौन-सी है?

subject: Maths
question: What is the largest number that divides n⁹ − n for every natural number n?
solution: n⁹ − n = n(n⁸ − 1), and n⁸ − 1 contains n² − 1 and n⁴ − 1. So it is divisible by 2, by 3 (n² leaves 1 when 3 does not divide n) and by 5 (n⁴ leaves 1 when 5 does not divide n): 30. It is not always divisible by 7: 2⁹ − 2 = 510 = 2 × 3 × 5 × 17. 3⁹ − 3 = 19,680 shares only 30 with 510.
questionHi: वह सबसे बड़ी संख्या कौन-सी है जो प्रत्येक प्राकृत संख्या n के लिए n⁹ − n को विभाजित करती है?
solutionHi: n⁹ − n = n(n⁸ − 1), और n⁸ − 1 में n² − 1 और n⁴ − 1 निहित। अतः यह 2 से, 3 से (3, n को विभाजित न करे तो n² का शेष 1) और 5 से (5, n को विभाजित न करे तो n⁴ का शेष 1) विभाज्य: 30। 7 से सदा नहीं: 2⁹ − 2 = 510 = 2 × 3 × 5 × 17। 3⁹ − 3 = 19,680 और 510 में केवल 30 उभयनिष्ठ।

subject: Maths
question: For every whole number n, 5²ⁿ⁺¹ + 2²ⁿ⁺¹ is divisible by:
solution: For an odd exponent, aᵏ + bᵏ is divisible by a + b = 7. n = 0 gives 5 + 2 = 7 itself, so 19, 133 and 3 do not always divide it.
questionHi: प्रत्येक पूर्ण संख्या n के लिए 5²ⁿ⁺¹ + 2²ⁿ⁺¹ किससे विभाज्य है?
solutionHi: विषम घातांक के लिए aᵏ + bᵏ, a + b = 7 से विभाज्य। n = 0 पर 5 + 2 = 7 ही, अतः 19, 133 और 3 सदा नहीं।

subject: Maths
question: For how many prime numbers p are 2p + 1 and 4p + 1 both prime as well?
solution: If p is not 3, it leaves 1 or 2 on division by 3. If it leaves 1, 2p + 1 is a multiple of 3; if 2, 4p + 1 is. Either way one of them is a multiple of 3 greater than 3. Only p = 3 works: 7 and 13 are prime. So 1.
questionHi: कितनी अभाज्य संख्याओं p के लिए 2p + 1 और 4p + 1 दोनों भी अभाज्य हैं?
solutionHi: यदि p, 3 नहीं, तो 3 से शेष 1 या 2। शेष 1 हो तो 2p + 1, 3 का गुणज; 2 हो तो 4p + 1। दोनों तरह एक 3 से बड़ा 3 का गुणज। केवल p = 3 चलता है: 7 और 13 अभाज्य। अतः 1।

subject: Maths
question: What is the least natural number that must be subtracted from 2²⁰²⁵ to make it divisible by 31?
solution: 2⁵ = 32 leaves 1 on division by 31, and 2,025 = 5 × 405, so 2²⁰²⁵ = (2⁵)⁴⁰⁵ leaves 1. Subtracting 1 makes it divisible.
questionHi: 2²⁰²⁵ में से कम से कम कौन-सी प्राकृत संख्या घटाएँ कि वह 31 से विभाज्य हो जाए?
solutionHi: 2⁵ = 32 का 31 से शेष 1, और 2,025 = 5 × 405, अतः 2²⁰²⁵ = (2⁵)⁴⁰⁵ का शेष 1। 1 घटाने पर विभाज्य।

subject: Maths
question: How many five-digit numbers that use each of the digits 1, 2, 3, 4 and 5 exactly once are divisible by 8?
solution: The last three digits must form a multiple of 8 with different digits from 1 to 5: 152, 312, 352, 432 and 512. For each, the other two digits fill the first places in 2 ways: 5 × 2 = 10.
questionHi: अंकों 1, 2, 3, 4 और 5 में से हर एक को ठीक एक बार प्रयोग करने वाली पाँच अंकों की कितनी संख्याएँ 8 से विभाज्य हैं?
solutionHi: अंतिम तीन अंक 1 से 5 के भिन्न अंकों से 8 का गुणज बनाएँ: 152, 312, 352, 432 और 512। हर एक के लिए बाकी दो अंक पहले स्थानों पर 2 तरह: 5 × 2 = 10।

question: What is the smallest natural number n for which n² is divisible by 72?
solution: 72 = 2³ × 3². n² has even powers of every prime, so it needs at least 2⁴ and 3²: n needs 2² × 3 = 12. (6² = 36 is not divisible by 72; 12² = 144 = 72 × 2.)
questionHi: वह सबसे छोटी प्राकृत संख्या n कौन-सी है जिसके लिए n², 72 से विभाज्य है?
solutionHi: 72 = 2³ × 3²। n² में हर अभाज्य की घात सम, अतः कम से कम 2⁴ और 3² चाहिए: n में 2² × 3 = 12। (6² = 36, 72 से विभाज्य नहीं; 12² = 144 = 72 × 2।)

subject: Maths
question: What is the smallest natural number n for which n³ is divisible by 180?
solution: 180 = 2² × 3² × 5. n³ contains each prime of n at least three times, so n needs just one each of 2, 3 and 5: n = 30 (30³ = 27,000 = 180 × 150).
questionHi: वह सबसे छोटी प्राकृत संख्या n कौन-सी है जिसके लिए n³, 180 से विभाज्य है?

question: By what smallest number must 1,080 be multiplied so that the product is divisible by 7! (= 5,040)?

question: For how many ordered pairs (a, b) with a and b from 1 to 30 is a² + b² divisible by 3?
solution: A square leaves 0 or 1 on division by 3, so a² + b² leaves 0 only when both squares leave 0, i.e. both a and b are multiples of 3. There are 10 multiples of 3 from 1 to 30: 10 × 10 = 100 pairs.
questionHi: 1 से 30 तक के a और b के कितने क्रमित युग्मों (a, b) के लिए a² + b², 3 से विभाज्य है?
solutionHi: वर्ग का 3 से शेष 0 या 1, अतः a² + b² का शेष 0 तभी जब दोनों वर्गों का शेष 0, यानी a और b दोनों 3 के गुणज। 1 से 30 में 3 के 10 गुणज: 10 × 10 = 100 युग्म।

subject: Maths
question: What is the largest number that divides n³ + 11n for every natural number n?
solution: n³ + 11n = (n³ − n) + 12n. n³ − n is a product of three consecutive numbers, divisible by 6, and 12n is too. So 6 always divides it. n = 1 gives 12 and n = 2 gives 30, whose HCF is 6.
questionHi: वह सबसे बड़ी संख्या कौन-सी है जो प्रत्येक प्राकृत संख्या n के लिए n³ + 11n को विभाजित करती है?
solutionHi: n³ + 11n = (n³ − n) + 12n। n³ − n तीन क्रमागत संख्याओं का गुणनफल, 6 से विभाज्य, और 12n भी। अतः 6 सदा विभाजित करता है। n = 1 पर 12 और n = 2 पर 30, जिनका HCF 6।

subject: Maths
question: a, b and c are whole numbers (positive, negative or zero) with a + b + c = 0. What is the largest number that always divides a³ + b³ + c³?
solution: When a + b + c = 0, a³ + b³ + c³ = 3abc. Three numbers adding to 0 cannot all be odd, so abc is even and 3abc is a multiple of 6. a = 1, b = 1, c = −2 gives 1 + 1 − 8 = −6, so nothing larger always divides it.
questionHi: a, b और c पूर्णांक (धनात्मक, ऋणात्मक या शून्य) हैं जिनके लिए a + b + c = 0। a³ + b³ + c³ को सदा विभाजित करने वाली सबसे बड़ी संख्या कौन-सी है?
solutionHi: जब a + b + c = 0, तो a³ + b³ + c³ = 3abc। 0 जोड़ने वाली तीनों संख्याएँ विषम नहीं हो सकतीं, अतः abc सम और 3abc, 6 का गुणज। a = 1, b = 1, c = −2 पर 1 + 1 − 8 = −6, अतः इससे बड़ी कोई सदा नहीं।

question: x and y are whole numbers such that 3x + 2y is divisible by 7. Which of the following is then always divisible by 7?
solution: 5 × (3x + 2y) = 15x + 10y = 14x + 7y + (x + 3y), so if 7 divides 3x + 2y it divides x + 3y. The others fail: for x = 4, y = 1, 3x + 2y = 14, but x + y = 5, 2x + y = 9 and 3x + y = 13.
questionHi: x और y पूर्ण संख्याएँ हैं जिनके लिए 3x + 2y, 7 से विभाज्य है। तब निम्नलिखित में से कौन सदा 7 से विभाज्य है?

question: What is the smallest natural number n for which n! is divisible by 3⁵⁰?

question: How many natural numbers n less than 100 have n² divisible by 12?
solution: n² divisible by 12 = 2² × 3 needs n divisible by 2 and by 3 (a square's primes come in pairs), i.e. by 6. Multiples of 6 below 100: 6 to 96, which is 16.
questionHi: 100 से कम कितनी प्राकृत संख्याओं n के लिए n², 12 से विभाज्य है?

question: For how many ordered pairs (a, b) with a and b from 1 to 20 is a² + b² divisible by 5?
solution: A square leaves 0, 1 or 4 on division by 5. The sum leaves 0 for (0, 0), (1, 4) and (4, 1). From 1 to 20: 4 numbers give 0, 8 give 1 (ending in 1, 4, 6, 9) and 8 give 4. 4 × 4 + 8 × 8 + 8 × 8 = 16 + 64 + 64 = 144.

question: How many four-digit numbers are divisible by 3, 7 and 11?
solution: Divisible by 3, 7 and 11 means divisible by 231. 231 × 5 = 1,155 is the first four-digit multiple and 231 × 43 = 9,933 the last: 43 − 5 + 1 = 39.

question: What is the smallest number that leaves remainders of 1, 2 and 3 when divided by 7, 8 and 9 respectively?
solution: Each remainder is 6 less than the divisor, so the number plus 6 is divisible by 7, 8 and 9, i.e. by 504. The smallest such number is 504 − 6 = 498.
questionHi: वह सबसे छोटी संख्या कौन-सी है जिसे 7, 8 और 9 से भाग देने पर क्रमशः 1, 2 और 3 शेष बचते हैं?

question: How many numbers from 1 to 1,000 are divisible by 3 and also have n² + 1 divisible by 5?
solution: n² + 1 is divisible by 5 when n leaves 2 or 3 on division by 5. Combined with n a multiple of 3, n leaves 3 or 12 on division by 15 - 2 in every 15. 1 to 990 has 66 blocks (132 numbers), and 991 to 1,000 adds 993 (993 = 15 × 66 + 3): 133.

question: What is the smallest number of 1s that a number written only with the digit 1 (11...1) must have to be divisible by 17?
solution: A number of k ones is (10ᵏ − 1) ÷ 9, and 9 shares no factor with 17, so we need 10ᵏ to leave 1 on division by 17. Powers of 10 leave 10, 15, 14, 4, 6, 9, 5, 16 (that is −1) at k = 8, so the first 1 comes at k = 16.
questionHi: केवल अंक 1 से लिखी संख्या (11...1) में 17 से विभाज्य होने के लिए कम से कम कितने 1 होने चाहिए?
solutionHi: k इकाइयों वाली संख्या (10ᵏ − 1) ÷ 9 है, और 9 का 17 से कोई उभयनिष्ठ गुणनखंड नहीं, अतः 10ᵏ का 17 से शेष 1 चाहिए। 10 की घातों के शेष 10, 15, 14, 4, 6, 9, 5, 16 (यानी −1) k = 8 पर, अतः पहला 1, k = 16 पर।

question: What is the smallest natural number n for which 5ⁿ − 1 is divisible by 31?

question: What is the largest number that divides n⁶ − n² for every natural number n?
solution: n⁶ − n² = n²(n⁴ − 1). For 4: n even makes n² a multiple of 4; n odd makes n⁴ − 1 a multiple of 16. For 3: n³ leaves the same remainder as n, so n⁶ leaves the same as n². For 5: n⁵ leaves the same as n, so n⁶ the same as n². So 60 divides it; 2⁶ − 2² = 60 itself.
questionHi: वह सबसे बड़ी संख्या कौन-सी है जो प्रत्येक प्राकृत संख्या n के लिए n⁶ − n² को विभाजित करती है?
solutionHi: n⁶ − n² = n²(n⁴ − 1)। 4 के लिए: n सम हो तो n², 4 का गुणज; n विषम हो तो n⁴ − 1, 16 का गुणज। 3 के लिए: n³ और n का शेष समान, अतः n⁶ और n² का भी। 5 के लिए: n⁵ और n का शेष समान, अतः n⁶ और n² का भी। अतः 60 विभाजित करता है; 2⁶ − 2² = 60 ही।

question: Which of 2²⁰²⁵ + 3²⁰²⁵, 2²⁰²⁴ + 3²⁰²⁴, 2²⁰²⁶ + 3²⁰²⁶ and 2²⁰²³ + 3²⁰²³ is divisible by 7?
solution: On division by 7, powers of 2 repeat every 3 (2, 4, 1) and powers of 3 every 6 (3, 2, 6, 4, 5, 1). 2,025 is a multiple of 3 and leaves 3 on division by 6: 1 + 6 = 7, divisible. For 2,024: 4 + 2 = 6; 2,026: 2 + 4 = 6; 2,023: 2 + 3 = 5.

question: What is the sum 1⁹⁹ + 2⁹⁹ + 3⁹⁹ + ... + 100⁹⁹ divisible by?
solution: Pair k with 101 − k: k⁹⁹ + (101 − k)⁹⁹ is divisible by k + (101 − k) = 101, because the power is odd. The 100 terms form 50 such pairs, so the sum is divisible by 101. It leaves 1 on division by 99 (and so by 9 and 11).
questionHi: योग 1⁹⁹ + 2⁹⁹ + 3⁹⁹ + ... + 100⁹⁹ किससे विभाज्य है?
solutionHi: k को 101 − k के साथ जोड़ें: k⁹⁹ + (101 − k)⁹⁹, k + (101 − k) = 101 से विभाज्य, क्योंकि घात विषम है। 100 पद ऐसे 50 जोड़े बनाते हैं, अतः योग 101 से विभाज्य। 99 से (अतः 9 और 11 से भी) शेष 1।

question: For how many natural numbers n from 1 to 100 is n² + 2n divisible by 8?
solution: n² + 2n = n(n + 2). For odd n it is odd. For even n = 2k it is 2k × (2k + 2) = 4k(k + 1), and k(k + 1) is even, so it is a multiple of 8. So exactly the 50 even values.
questionHi: 1 से 100 तक कितनी प्राकृत संख्याओं n के लिए n² + 2n, 8 से विभाज्य है?
solutionHi: n² + 2n = n(n + 2)। विषम n पर यह विषम। सम n = 2k पर 2k × (2k + 2) = 4k(k + 1), और k(k + 1) सम, अतः 8 का गुणज। अतः ठीक 50 सम मान।

question: What is the largest number that divides 2,436, 4,788 and 7,644 leaving the same remainder in each case?
solution: If all three leave the same remainder, the divisor divides their differences: 4,788 − 2,436 = 2,352, 7,644 − 4,788 = 2,856 and 7,644 − 2,436 = 5,208. HCF(2,352, 2,856) = 168, and 5,208 = 168 × 31. So 168 (each number leaves 84).

subject: Maths
question: How many four-digit numbers abcd have a + b = c + d and are also divisible by 11?
solution: Divisible by 11 needs (a + c) − (b + d) to be 0 or ±11; with all four digits summing to 2(a + b), an even number, it must be 0: a + c = b + d. Together with a + b = c + d this gives a = d and b = c: the numbers abba. a has 9 choices and b has 10: 90.
questionHi: चार अंकों की कितनी संख्याएँ abcd ऐसी हैं कि a + b = c + d और वे 11 से भी विभाज्य हैं?
solutionHi: 11 से विभाज्यता के लिए (a + c) − (b + d), 0 या ±11 हो; चारों अंकों का योग 2(a + b) सम है, अतः 0: a + c = b + d। a + b = c + d के साथ इससे a = d और b = c: संख्याएँ abba। a के 9 और b के 10 विकल्प: 90।

subject: Maths
question: Which of the following does NOT divide the number written with twenty 1s (111...1, 20 digits)?
solution: A number of k ones divides one of m ones when k divides m. 11 (two 1s), 1,111 = 11 × 101 (four 1s) and 11,111 = 41 × 271 (five 1s) all divide the twenty-1s number, since 2, 4 and 5 divide 20. 37 first divides 111 (three 1s), and 3 does not divide 20.
questionHi: बीस इकाइयों से लिखी संख्या (111...1, 20 अंक) को निम्नलिखित में से कौन विभाजित नहीं करता?
solutionHi: k इकाइयों वाली संख्या m इकाइयों वाली को तब विभाजित करती है जब k, m को विभाजित करे। 11 (दो 1), 1,111 = 11 × 101 (चार 1) और 11,111 = 41 × 271 (पाँच 1) सभी बीस इकाइयों वाली को विभाजित करते हैं, क्योंकि 2, 4 और 5, 20 को विभाजित करते हैं। 37 पहली बार 111 (तीन 1) को विभाजित करता है, और 3, 20 को विभाजित नहीं करता।

question: How many numbers from 1,000 to 2,000 are divisible by both 16 and 9?
solution: Divisible by 16 and 9 means divisible by 144. 144 × 7 = 1,008 and 144 × 13 = 1,872 (144 × 14 = 2,016 is too big): 13 − 7 + 1 = 7.

question: How many three-digit numbers are divisible by 5 and leave a remainder of 3 when divided by 28?
solution: The numbers leaving 3 on division by 28 are 3, 31, 59, 87, 115, ...; the first multiple of 5 among them is 115, and then every LCM(5, 28) = 140: 115, 255, 395, 535, 675, 815, 955. All seven are three-digit numbers (1,095 is too big): 7.
